title: Wait for an active publisher through a slow first model download
requirement: Slow forward progress from the competing publisher must extend its idle deadline, with bounded waiting, cancellation and independent validation after acquisition.
fixture_isolation: The parent runs each lock case in its own test process with a private home set before startup, waits for that whole process, then removes the fixture.
fixture_stress: 12 full library runs, three processes in parallel and 16 test threads per process: 1,236 passed tests, zero failures, zero remaining private lock fixtures. The optional publisher-cache test is reported separately.
